top_issues: Settings desktop: scale slider and preset pill buttons ($1, $2, $5, $10...) are visually disconnected and create redundant controls for one parameter.
Settings desktop: right-hand preview card is vertically short, leaving vast empty space beneath it on standard desktop resolutions.

fixes: Settings desktop: merge the preset scale chips into discrete notch markers on the slider track itself or group them directly underneath as a segmented bar.
Settings desktop: wrap Vault actions into a cohesive security card with status indicators (e.g. key derivation method, encrypted state).
Settings desktop: expand 'AT THIS SCALE' preview card with an interactive test input to immediately visualize custom transaction sizes.

overall.verdict: xln desktop dark establishes an exceptionally strong, authoritative fintech aesthetic with crisp cryptographic cues and elegant bilateral bar concepts. Its primary weakness is desktop canvas utilization, leaving extensive dark dead zones and underpopulated second columns across secondary views.
priority_fixes: Default-select the first transaction in Activity view on desktop so the right-hand receipt pane is never an empty placeholder box.
Bring the visceral value bilateral bar into the Receipt modal and Activity detail pane to visually corroborate the settlement delta.
Provide active selection styling (surface fill #1A1F2C + indicator border) to list rows when viewing details side-by-side.
Rebalance desktop vertical layout across Pay, Swap, and Account pages by adding route stats, execution parameters, or transaction history rather than leaving 60% empty canvas.
Enclose the Receive QR code in an elegant, padded dark container card with a softly framed off-white QR plate to eliminate harsh unstyled contrast.
